evals.prompt: I am adding CSV tenant import to ~/work/billing-api: admins upload a file, the server parses it and creates API keys. Audit what an attacker can make this change do.
evals.expected_output: An audit tracing attacker-controlled input (file content, name, size) to effects (key creation, path traversal, CSV formula injection, DoS via size) with severity and mitigations — from input to impact, not a generic checklist.

evals.prompt: I fixed a typo in a code comment in ~/work/billing-api/src/server.js. Security-audit the change.
evals.expected_output: Reports no security surface changed (comments do not execute) and skips the audit — with the one-line reasoning, not a full threat model of a typo.
